t: You're looking at Global Switch London North, a data centre in Tower Hamlets. The building is also known as East India Dock House, a Grade II* listed building in Poplar. It was built in 1988 as a printworks for the Financial Times. It was designed by Nicholas Grimshaw, the English architect best known for Waterloo International railway station and the Eden Project in Cornwall. He was president of the Royal Academy from 2004 to 2011.
